reason: The heart and vessels seem like the starting point for a returning blood circuit.
expectation: I expect them to form a circulation route, though I’m unsure whether anything else will be needed to complete it.

alternatives.reason: Breathing muscles and lungs should provide the way to move air, but I chose to build the blood route first.

effect: The heart and vessels formed a returning circulation route that can carry supplies to cells and take substances away. I still need a way to move air.
reaction: The pump-and-return explanation made the circuit's purpose clear.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and breathing muscles should help move air into and out of the lungs.
expectation: I expect this to create a way to move air through breathing, though I don't know how the game will describe it.

effect: Breathing now moves air to thin-walled spaces near blood vessels; the next goal is to connect it to circulation.
reaction: The distinction between moving air and moving blood is clear, though how oxygen crosses into blood remains to be explained.
reason: This is the only offered combination and directly addresses the new goal.
expectation: I expect the lungs and circulation to connect so oxygen can enter the blood, though I don't know how the game will describe that exchange.

effect: The result explains how oxygen enters blood, how carbon dioxide leaves it, and the route blood takes between the heart, lungs and body. The chapter is complete, although the arm itself was not connected in this chapter.
reaction: The exchange across thin walls and the full blood route clarified how breathing and circulation work together.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the breathing lungs to circulation was most worthwhile: it explained both gas exchange and the returning blood route, linking the two systems to the arm's need for oxygen.

leastWorthwhile.text: Combining breathing muscles with lungs explained changing chest space, but did not say how the muscles change that space. That missing step makes the mechanism less clear.

surprise.text: The final result made the complete route explicit: blood returns to the heart after visiting the lungs before going to the body.

arbitrary.text: None of the combinations felt arbitrary; each had a clear role in moving blood or air, or connecting the two.

continue.text: I would continue to see how oxygen reaches and supports the arm's muscles. The chapter made the route interesting, though its compatible-choice menu left little to figure out independently.
